sources.source: OpenAI - Running Codex safely at OpenAI
sources.control_signal: Bounded execution, managed configuration, approvals, network policy, and agent-native telemetry should shape THOS runner publication discipline.

sources.source: Model Context Protocol - Security Best Practices
sources.control_signal: MCP-style connectors need explicit trust boundaries, consent handling, scope minimization, and SSRF-aware routing.
Skill evolution should keep inventory, approval workflow, isolation, permission review, version pinning, and audit logging front-and-center.
Future watcher receipts should separate agent spans, model spans, events, exceptions, and metrics for cleaner observability.
Agentic automation needs cautious MCP implementation because dynamic tool invocation, implicit trust, and context sharing create systemic risks.
